item.title: Indonesian Stocks Plunge as MSCI Threatens to Drop Market from Indexes

item.title: Feel Like You’re Overpaying for Hotels? Blame Expedia, a New Lawsuit Says.
item.description: The booking giant is accused of breaking federal antitrust laws and forcing millions of customers to overspend on stays by as much as 30 percent.
item.dc:creator: Ryley Ober
item.media:credit: Serene Lee/SOPA Images, via LightRocket, via Getty Images
item.media:description: If a hotel offered a lower price on a competing platform, the suit claims Expedia would make the hotel harder to find on the company’s platforms.

item.title: Lufthansa’s Final A346 Flight Marks the End of an Aviation Love Story
